","type":"text/x-markdown","caption":"streams ports"},"/home/runner/work/tw-plugin-library/tw-plugin-library/wiki/plugins/rimir/streams-ports/README.md":{"title":"/home/runner/work/tw-plugin-library/tw-plugin-library/wiki/plugins/rimir/streams-ports/README.md","text":"# Streams ports Brings [rimir/ports](https://github.com/rimir-cc/tw-ports) into [Streams](https://saqimtiaz.github.io/streams/): every typed stream row gets its own port handle, lined up on the tiddler's right border, and rows are drop targets for wires. ## Features - **Row handles** — a row whose node has a `kind.type` shows its handle while you hover the row; the tiddler's own handle steps back meanwhile. - **Owner highlight** — while you hover a row's handle, open its port list or drag one of its ports, that row is tinted with a bar on its left edge, so you see which node the port belongs to even on wide screens. - **Rows as targets** — drop a wire onto a stream row to link that node. - **No parent port** — `parent` is left out on rows (configurable), since the stream already shows it and Streams manages it together with `stream-list`. ## Prerequisites - [rimir/ports](https://github.com/rimir-cc/tw-ports) - [rimir/kind-streams](https://github.com/rimir-cc/tw-kind-streams) (its row add-on hook places the handle) - [sq/streams](https://saqimtiaz.github.io/streams/) Rows need a `kind.type` to have ports; untyped rows show nothing. ## Quick Start 1. Give a stream row a kind type (Streams context menu → **Kind type**). 2. Hover the row, then the dot on the tiddler's right border at the row's height. 3. Drag a port onto another tiddler, row or dock tile. ## License MIT — see [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md). What it does A bridge between [[rimir/ports|$:/plugins/rimir/ports]] and Streams. Ports itself only knows story tiddlers and its dock; this plugin adds the stream rows, so ports stays free of anything Streams-specific. !! Pieces |!Tiddler |!Role | |`row-handle` |Row add-on (`$:/tags/rimir/kind-streams/row-addon`): transcludes ports' `handle` for the node with variant `row` and the configured exclusions | |`target-row` |Drop target spec (`$:/tags/rimir/ports/target`): `.stream-row[data-node-title]` | |`styles` |Row handle height, show-on-row-hover, hides the tiddler's handle while a row is hovered, row highlight while dragging, owner-row tint while its handle is hovered, open or dragged | |`$:/config/rimir/streams-ports/exclude` |Ref fields without a port on rows (default `parent`) | !! Placement kind-streams' `stream-row-body` override renders row add-ons at the start of each row's body. The handle is absolutely positioned with `right: -8px` but without `top`: the nearest positioned ancestor is the tiddler frame, so it lands on the frame's right border, at the row's own height. Streams' row elements are not positioned, so this holds for nested rows too. !! Why `parent` is left out A row's `parent` is its place in the stream. Streams keeps it in step with the parent's `stream-list`; writing `parent` alone would leave the row listed under its old parent. Moving rows stays with Streams' drag and drop.
